resolution: The A_5 rank-strata equations are established on main through PR 550: the covering re-derived over Q in Singular independently of the author's slice certificates, every principal Pfaffian of orders 12, 10, 8 in the piece ideals, and Ehat equal to E8-bar, irreducible of dimension 11 and degree 24.
